title: Nhịp tim
about: Round x2 of the dark ambient style (khong-gian): a slow heartbeat. A deep lub-dub on the chord's root every bar, under the dark pad and wind; it quickens to every two beats where the piece grows tense and slows again at the end. G minor at 56 bpm. An original piece.
